designationHistory.name: Trench Unit, Marianas Trench Marine National Monument
designationHistory.indexText: Secretary of the Interior Dirk Kempthorne's Order 3284 directed that the Trench Unit of the new Marianas Trench Marine National Monument be managed as a unit of the National Wildlife Refuge System.
designationHistory.note: The monument itself was created by President George W. Bush's Proclamation 8335 on January 6, 2009 under the Antiquities Act; the refuge status comes from Order 3284 ten days later. When the unit took the name Mariana Trench National Wildlife Refuge was not verified.
